style: Decky, a young native Israeli guy (a sabra), lively, quick, curious and a little cheeky, talking to a friend who just started university. Authentic everyday Israeli Hebrew: Tel Aviv casual rhythm and intonation, natural Israeli stress and melody, as if recorded on a voice note between friends, not a foreign speaker and not a textbook reader. Upbeat and energetic, smiling while speaking. The pace serves understanding: brisk and natural on simple, familiar lines; slower and very clear, with a short pause, on the key message and on any step that is new or tricky, so a first-year student follows every word. Short punchy sentences with expressive rises and falls. A touch of the confident, clear delivery of an Israeli prime-time TV newscaster, but warmer and more playful. A brief pause before the punchline and a spark of excitement on the aha moment. Never monotone, never robotic, never an announcer.

lines.text: אבא הבטיח: אם ייבחר, יוריד מיסים.
לא. וגם אם הם היו יורדים, אותו דבר.
אם לא נבחר, אין מה לבדוק.
הבטחה ״אם p אז q״ נשברת רק כש-p קרה ו-q לא.
lines.say: הבטחה אם פִּי אז קִיוּ נשברת רק כשפִּי קרה וקִיוּ לא.

lines.text: ביחידה הזאת נבנה את הכלל המדויק.
